packageRules.description: Fixture pin coupled to tests/fixtures/repin/verification.lock.json. Not a runtime dependency. Renovate's packageName for this git source is Living-Proof-Labs/livingproof-sim-mujoco; the dependency name stays livingproof-sim-mujoco. Move it only in a migration that updates the lock with the pin.
Legacy demo image held at 1.6.0. tools/check_demo.py requires that reporter; move it only in a migration that updates the guard with the pin.

Self image. Each release publishes a new capability-verifier-hallway image, and an automerged pin to it is a releasable commit that publishes another image (the v2.7.0, v2.7.1, v2.7.2 loop on 2026-11-18). Keep the pin at a reviewed release: no automerge, and at most one proposal a month, merged deliberately.
